text:

title: LU NIS2 Transposition 2024 — section 2
text:
ACTUAL STATUS — LUXEMBOURG NIS2 TRANSPOSITION:
The Luxembourg NIS2 transposition is Project de loi n° 8364 (parliamentary bill).

title: LU NIS2 Transposition 2024 — section 3
text:
Legilux SPARQL metadata (data.legilux.public.lu) confirms as of April 2026:
  - Bill status: "en-cours" (in progress / in committee)
  - Parliament dossier: https://www.chd.lu/fr/dossier/8364
  - SPARQL ELI URI: http://data.legilux.public.lu/eli/dl/pl/2024/49
  - Bill title: "Projet de loi concernant des mesures destinées à assurer un niveau
    élevé de cybersécurité et portant modification de:
    1° la loi modifiée du 14 août 2000 relative au commerce électronique ;
    2° la loi modifiée du 23 juillet 2016 portant création d'un Haut-Commissariat
       à la Protection nationale ;
    3° la loi du 17 décembre 2021 sur les réseaux et les services de communications"
  - Transposition of: Directive (UE) 2022/2555 (NIS2)
  - Foresees repeal of: Loi du 28 mai 2019 (NIS1 transposition, ELI a372)
  - NIS2 transposition deadline (EU): 2024-10-17 (Luxembourg is in default)
  - Acceptance at Conseil de Gouvernement: 2024-02-21
  - Deposited at Chambre des Députés: March 13, 2024
  - Current phase: En commission (April 13, 2026 — presentation of draft report)
  - No vote, no promulgation, no Journal Officiel publication as of April 2026

title: LU NIS2 Transposition 2024 — section 4
text:
LEGILUX PORTAL:
- URL: https://legilux.public.lu
- Technology: JavaScript SPA (Angular), requires JS-enabled browser for all content
- API settings: https://legilux.public.lu/api/settings (returns ElasticSearch + Casemates config)
- SPARQL endpoint: https://data.legilux.public.lu/sparqlendpoint (Virtuoso, publicly accessible)
- File formats available for ENACTED laws: HTML, XML, PDF/A, DOCX (via SPARQL-discovered URIs)
- Authentication: NOT required — Legilux is publicly accessible
- Files are served at: https://legilux.public.lu/{eli-path} (served by SPA) OR
  directly at: data.legilux.public.lu/filestore/eli/... (requires correct filename pattern)
- Example accessible file: http://data.legilux.public.lu/eli/etat/leg/loi/2024/05/22/a219/jo/fr/html

CONFIRMED FACTS:
- Luxembourg's highest Memorial A number in 2024 is a604 (December 2024)
- "a1426" does not correspond to any 2024 Luxembourg law (numbers only go to ~604)
- The NIS2 bill was still in committee as of April 2026 (over 18 months past EU deadline)
- Luxembourg is in infringement for failing to transpose NIS2 by October 17, 2024

title: LU NIS2 Transposition 2024 — section 5
text:
WHEN THE LAW IS EVENTUALLY ENACTED:
It will appear in Legilux as: http://data.legilux.public.lu/eli/etat/leg/loi/YYYY/MM/DD/aXXX/jo
Available formats will include: HTML, XML, PDF/A, DOCX (confirmed for all 2024+ laws)
Text will be accessible via SPARQL or direct URL once published.

SPARQL QUERY TO CHECK STATUS:
curl -G "https://data.legilux.public.lu/sparqlendpoint" \
  --data-urlencode 'query=PREFIX jolux: <http://data.legilux.public.lu/resource/ontology/jolux#>
  SELECT ?s ?status WHERE { <http://data.legilux.public.lu/eli/dl/pl/2024/49> jolux:statusDraft ?status . }' \
  -H "Accept: application/sparql-results+json"

DATE CHECKED: 2026-04-04
